environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) running Amazon Linux 2, behind a Network Load Balancer (NLB) with TCP passthrough on port 443. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No application-layer inspection. SQLite database on local EBS volume. Flask served via gunicorn with 4 workers. Instance profile has no special permissions. CloudWatch agent collects only system metrics (CPU, memory, disk).

config.load_balancer: NLB with TCP listener on 443, target group health check on /health
config.monitoring: CloudWatch agent - system metrics only, no request logging
config.network: public subnet, no NAT gateway, direct internet access
